content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NHM Nalgonda Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026 is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 41 vacancies announced for various Medical and Paramedical posts under the National Health Mission Nalgonda Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 44 years, with applicable age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a merit list based on qualifying examination marks and age weightage, followed by the display of provisional and final merit lists, and counseling.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the highest salary offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered for the Pediatrician/Medical Officers post is Rs. 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Which qualifications are required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: For the Lab Technician post, candidates need to have completed Intermediate and a Diploma/Certified course in MLT or an equivalent qualification, and be registered with the paramedical board of TG.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job type for the NHM Nalgonda Recruitment 2026 is contract-based.
